comment: Seeds every pull request runs. Append any seed the extended suite fails on (CONFORMANCE_SEEDS=1-500), with a note, so it stays a regression test.

regressions.note: A stream that trickled bytes without completing a frame kept the Flutter client attached (liveness counted bytes); now counts complete frames, as the JS SDKs do.

known_failures.sdks: 173: node, web, react-native, flutter; 184: web (depends on timing)
known_failures.note: A delayed stream replay applied at ready can roll back flags polled meanwhile; pre-existing (v0.1.30 fails 173). Not in `seeds` until fixed; move them there with the fix. See docs/releases/v0.1.31/RELIABILITY-REVIEW.md.
